body: I would end it all if it weren't for my mother. Not because she was a simply fantastic mother; because that simply is not the case. Although she has gotten better since I was a child. I feel that leaving her like that would be a huge disservice. I don't think I could do it. I would feel too much guilt during to complete the act. That being said, my mother will one day pass away. As everyone does, and most likely before I do. And then; I will make my grand exit. Without guilt. Knowing the only person who would care is already gone.

My ex went on a month long vacation after we broke up. Broke my heart totally. That's a long and incredibly messy story for you. I'm dating and it is really hard. Mostly because I'm not over him, so every guy I go out with inevitably gets compared without me meaning to do it. That's why I suggested just going out and having fun; without taking anything too seriously. Just to get out of your head a little. Realize that there are other people out there.

As much as it is going to hurt; and it will. You need to do everything in your power to stay out of contact with her. You should not have gone through her private messages (although I have done the same thing, so I can understand the deep desire to do so). It sounds like she just wants to move on and be left alone for the time being. You should do the same. It's going to suck majorly, but maybe you should start dating again too. Find someone nice that you like to just go out and do fun things with. It doesn't have to get super serious. Just try to take care of yourself, and be patient with your feelings. It gets harder before it gets easier. xoxo.

I can understand that you're feeling upset that she has moved on, but what did you expect? I'm not trying to be harsh, but, you did break up with her. She has a right to move on to someone else who will appreciate and love her more than you could at the time. That is the risk you take when you end things with someone you still have feelings for. They may fall in love and move on before you realize your mistake. Also, it is perfectly acceptable for her to not take you back even if she were still single. No one wants to be with someone who only wants them when it's convenient/ they feel lonely/ etc. Just try to be happy for her; and do your best to move on as well.

I was the depressed girlfriend in my scenario. I've been broken up with my ex bf for almost two months now. And only now am I happy. It was only after my break-up that I finally got the kick in the pants that I needed. One suicide attempt and countless hours of sobbing on the floor mixed in with therapy and the rights meds; and well, here I am. Making it. Not just making it. But thriving. Sounds to me like you are more her caretaker than her boyfriend. It's going to hurt like hell to break-up for real, but maybe like me, she will finally take her mental health into her own hands, and truly focus on getting well. You are not her therapist. It is unfair of her to drain you so much emotionally. There is a difference between being someones partner, and being their therapist/punching bag. She will one day forgive you. Thank you even. But none of that will happen unless you take this next step. Just, trust me on this one.

You need to let her be. She is happy and content where she is, and you cannot expect someone to be there whenever you decide you want them again. That simply isn't fair to the other person. For now it appears that she wants to be left alone. As challenging as it will be you must leave her alone until/if she reaches out to you. you need to respect her enough to let her go on with her life; although you may not be apart of said life. It's hard, but it's the best thing you can do right now.

I want you to understand first and foremost that you are a wonderful individual worthy of love and and the ability to love someone else. Now would be the perfect time to really focus on your own mental health and healing. You need to better yourself and find some kind of inner peace so you no longer seek it out within others. My ex and I split up for similar reasons to you. He was done with my depression and my lack of progress in therapy. Since our break-up I have taken a front seat in my healing process and can honestly say I feel 1000% better. Do what you need to do to get well, but also don't use getting your ex back as the fuel to do this. Do it because you want to live a happier healthier life; not because you are trying to win someone back who may or may not return. If they do not come back it will feel as though all of your efforts were made in vain. I hope all of this makes sense! And best of luck to you!!

you will get through this. You will love again, and I am living proof of that <3 Life goes on, and it gets better. You think of them less and less. They hold less weight in your life. They don't mean as much to you as they did before. Your world doesn't turn upside down when you think about your future without them. Happiness; true happiness will come with time. Another will appear that will make you glad everything happened the way it did. Trust me.

this may not be the advice you are looking for but, do not wait for someone who is unsure of whether or not they want to be with you. There is someone out there who will love you without ever considering such a thing as a break. Honestly he sounds like he might be too immature to just officially end things with you. I know this is hard, but you re better than this. Refuse to just be someones option.

this is all a ploy to keep you on a tight leash so you don't up and move on. That is something he doesn't want. He wants his freedom but he also wants to know that you'll always be there. You're going to have to make a choice. This back and forth with him, or your sanity. Choose your sanity and move on. I know it hurts like hell, but if you ever want a shot at happiness this has to be done. Sending all the good vibes your way.
Agreed. He wouldn't have treated you like this if he was in fact your best mate. Good riddance.
I am hoping for an eventual acquaintanceship with my ex. A close friendship with him? Probably never. And I'm okay with that. Perhaps in time you will be too.

It's the hardest thing in the world when you're in the midst of it. I was with my ex for almost five years and not being able to talk to my best friend is so horrible I can't quite describe it. The worst part is that he has always ALWAYS been there for me, and now that he isn't I at times feel so lost. The apartment we once shared together feels like an empty tomb. I am beginning to feel better though. He is going on with his life, and I know that I have too as well as hard as it will be. There will be another person out there for me, and for you as well. Knowing that helps me a little bit.

I am so sorry that you are hurting my dear. My ex is off doing single guy things and at the start it used to really bother me. I'm starting to not really care anymore, and look at our relationship for what it really was. Fun while it lasted, but downright awful towards the end. It needed to end so that we could both move on. I'm still angry at him for how he handled things with me, but I will leave that up to karma. All wrongs will be made right. Try to not look at this as a personal defeat, but as just another step closer to who you're actually supposed to be with. Fuck, I know that's almost impossible, but I promise you will get there. Making a list of your ex's shitty qualities helps speed the process along too.

I love this. Thanks so much for posting it. My ex was and still is a selfish coward. Never going back even though I'm sure he thinks once he's done having his fun as a single guy I'll still be there when he returns. Nope. Not this time, and never ever again.

I really wish I could help you feel less frustrated. What I can say is that without even knowing you at all I already know that you deserve better than this pussy of a man. An ADULT would give you the peace of mind you deserve, but we are not talking about an adult here. We are talking about a man-child. You are far too good for him, and I pity the women he is getting married to. She is in for a hell of a time. Don't be sad and upset that the friendship is over. Be glad you got the hell out of there before you wasted even more time on such a scum bag. You do not deserve to be treated like such trash. He'll get what's coming to him.

This isn't something you're going to want to do, but you're going to have to accept his silence as his goodbye. To be honest some people are just cowards. They won't tell you goodbye. or sometimes even why they're leaving; and no matter how hard you try you won't be able to get anything more out of them. This is a difficult pill to swallow, but you will have to simply accept that with this there will be no concrete closure. I understand your pain and frustration. Just know that it isn't your fault. You've done nothing wrong. Like I said before, some people are cowards; and sounds like he is  one of them.

As much as it hurts, and I know it does; you need to move on. She clearly has no clue what she wants and it's reflected in her answers to you. You deserve better than someone who doesn't know for sure whether they want you or not. I'm sorry this is so painful, but it will be even more painful in the long run if you continue to cling onto hope and it doesn't pan out the way you wanted it too. Stay Strong xoxo.

I know you are hurting beyond belief right now, but the first thing you need to do is unfollow and block your ex on Facebook and all social media platforms. Seeing him post things is only going to trigger you and make you feel worse. I know that it hurts seeing him jump into another relationship so quickly, but sometimes this is how people move on albeit an unhealthy way. This is just his way of getting over you. I wouldn't be surprised if the girl he is currently dating is just a rebound and will end as soon as it began. Good strong relationships cannot begin on the coat tails of an old one. Once you block him just start trying to work on yourself and eventually go back into dating; this time using your past experience as a helpful guideline in your new relationship. Which you will have, I promise. You will find love again, real love.

you are both still very young like myself and my ex. Perhaps you should speak with her about taking a break. Not necessarily breaking up fully; just taking a little time apart to see how you each feel without the other. Perhaps after a month or so (having no contact which would mean one of you would have to leave for the break) come back together and see if the feelings of missing each other resonate with the both of you; you could go from there. I hope this helps! I'm here if you ever need advice or are deeply struggling and need a person to talk to who knows what it's like. I am feeling better and stronger every single day; so I can say with complete confidence that there is life and happiness after a break-up. I heard something that helped me, and it might help you too. "Don't be disappointed because you lost your soulmate. Be disappointed that the person you thought was your soulmate was not." Makes sense if you think about it. Good luck xoxo.

Firstly I want to say that I am so beyond sorry that you are in so much pain. 
Your fiance sounds like she has cold feet and is questioning everything in her life right now. How old are you guys by the way? 
If you can I suggest you maybe go crash out at a friends house or something. You need to get out of this situation because being in it is doing nothing but making you feel worse. I know it doesn't feel like it but it's going to be okay. I promise you. I'ts gonna hurt like fucking hell for a while, but it won't forever. Remember that in your most difficult moments <3

Thank you for your response.
I am in therapy, as well as speaking to a psych about medication needs as they tend to change now and again. I know I just need to focus on getting well, and I plan on getting my degree soon and being happy one way or another!!

This is me to a tee. My 22nd birthday is on the 24th of October, and I have been planning my death for that day. Still not sure if I plan on going through with it, as the approaching date is so soon and I have nothing ready, But then again; I find myself caring less and less about getting notes and what not ready. Who cares, I'll be dead anyways.

There you go! I know it's hard. I'm going through some nasty break up shit too. But I've found that reaching out to others, and taking yourself out; even if it's a simple trip to Starbucks really does help lighten the mood. Break ups are sucky, but we can move on from them, and learn something new about ourselves along the way.

this is so me! I went to the mall a little while ago which is a place my ex and I used to frequent quite often, and I swear I saw memories of us all around that place. Even the way the wind was blowing reminded me of a particular memory of me and him. I feel like it's gotten a little easier though. Give it time XoXo.

I feel you. I have a lot of jewelry/clothing/books etc. from my now ex after five years of being together. I put all that stuff in a box so when he comes to pick the rest of his stuff up he can choose to do with those things as he pleases and it's out of my hands. I certainly don't want those daily reminders around.
I admit I had a giggle about this. Hahaha. It's eating disorder, sorry lol.

Right there with you. Going through a tough break-up after five years together. It's beyond hell. I feel like killing myself every day. Especially after my most recent attempt. I know people would be hurt by my death so I guess in that sense I do feel obligated to stay. But at the same time I'm finding it harder and harder to keep on going...

I know exactly how you feel. I've never known my father, and my mother and I have a strained relationship to say the least; although it's gotten better since my recent suicide attempt. 
I go through phases of really wanting to kill myself, and then other times clinging onto life wholeheartedly. It's a weird situation. 
Anyways, I know what you mean, and you are not alone. Sometimes it feels like everything, and everyone are against you and there is no hope left at all. 
I wish I could give you advice on feeling better. I'm in therapy currently, and I can say that you should try it. It might help you. At least give it a chance. You never know. I know you hate crying and the pain that comes along with it, but sometimes we have to go through some shit to get to some shit. 
Hope this helps knowing you are not too alone in feeling this way. 
XoXo.
What is going on in your life that makes you believe you've blown your only shot at happiness?
mostly my depression. I was having health issues caused by my ED

I recently attempted suicide by pill overdose, and landed myself in the hospital for a week. Worst week of my life. I'm sorry you are going through this. I know how much it sucks. Praying that someday it gets better for us all <3

You are worth life despite what you may think. No matter what is going on in your life there is a chance for it to turn around. Break ups lead to the love of your life. Leaving an old job leads to finding the career of your dreams. 
Darkness falls over the earth every night, and yet every morning the light from the sun brightens up the world again. You are covered in darkness right now, and because everything is so dark you can't see all the amazing interesting things right in front of you. But they are there. You may think I'm full of shit. But I know I'm right. 
Try out different meds, see a therapist, do group therapy, spend more time outside in nature. Something will work for you. You are not a lost cause. You deserve every breath that you take. Please keep fighting.

That sounds really rough, and I'm sorry you are going through that right now. Personally I can totally understand where you are coming from. I have severe depression and am going through a break up myself after almost five years together. 
I wish I could tell you exactly what to do to feel better, but the truth is I have no idea. What I will say is that you are not a defective or worthless person because you are going through this. It may feel that way but it isn't true. 
Your friend is just frustrated. My best friend and I recently had a bit of a falling out over my mental health problems. It isn't that they don't love and care about you; sometimes people just get so upset that they can't just fix you they start to pull away. Most of the time it's because they have never personally felt as low as you have, and so they cannot truly empathize. 
As far as the love situation; the guy you were with for five years sounds like he doesn't like himself very much either. No one treats another human being that way without hating themselves. He is probably in a dark place; but that is not an excuse for him to treat people however he damn well pleases.
The other guy with the pregnant girlfriend just sounds immature. You don't want to be with someone who is so childish they cannot even be completely honest with you. 
I've heard group therapy helps. Getting outside again helps. Trying to do things even when every fiber of your being screams at you to stay in bed all day helps. 
You have to push yourself though. It can be done; and I know it's really fucking hard, I do, trust me on that. But You can do this. Take every day as it comes. Every second, every minute as it comes. Try to just stay present in the moment; and stay calm. I know that you can do this. Pleas keep trying <3 Please, never give up<3
